desc: Derive why preserving the longest palindromic suffix and appending the reverse of the preceding prefix yields a shortest palindrome.
Formulate the KMP construction `reverse(S) + separator + S` for finding the longest palindromic suffix.
Implement a linear-time prefix-function suitable for strings up to length 500,000.
Verify edge cases including a one-character string, an already-palindromic string, and strings with no palindromic suffix longer than one.
